pages.title: Somewhere Else
pages.text: The place an Overload Ritual opens onto isn't a pocket of your own making - it's shared, the same way the Nether is shared, not a private room like the one your Pact can open. Anyone's ritual leads into the same hollow, just by a different door.

pages.title: A Held Breath
pages.text: The ground here doesn't rise and fall like the surface does - it's flat, deliberate, and quiet in a way that feels less like a landscape and more like something built and then abandoned. Ruined chambers are scattered throughout, spaced far enough apart that finding the next one takes real walking.

pages.title: Something Waits
pages.text: You won't be walking long before you find what the network's overload was really reaching toward. It doesn't seem to have moved in a very long time. That's about to change.
